1.desc: 1.Log in and go online to complete

2.desc: 2.Sweep, sweep completed (regardless of whether you watched the ad), click to jump to the main interface and sweep the furthest level

3.desc: 3.Daily store, any product in the daily store to complete, click to jump to the daily store

4.desc: 4.Participate in the gameplay, participate in a specific gameplay to complete, click to jump to the specific gameplay

5.desc: 5.Consume diamonds. After consuming any diamonds, click Go to jump to the store interface.

6.desc: 6.Consume gold coins. After the consumption of gold coins is completed, click Go to jump to the equipment interface

7.desc: 7.Consume physical strength, consume physical strength to complete, click to jump to the main level interface

8.desc: 8.Watch the ad. After watching any ad, click to jump to the box drawing.

9.desc: 9.Upgrade equipment. After upgrading any equipment, click Go to jump to the equipment interface.

10.desc: 10.Complete the main line, complete the specific level of the main line, click Go to jump to the main line level interface

11.desc: 11.The treasure chest is opened. After opening any box, click Go to jump to the box drawing.

12.desc: 12.Kill the monsters. After killing any monster, click Go to jump to the main level interface.

13.desc: 13.Kill the BOSS. After killing any BOSS, click Go to jump to the main level interface.

14.desc: 14.Equipment level, the highest level of equipment reaches the specified level, click to jump to the equipment interface
